name: v6-same-text-two-types
note: vault/vault.shroud, vault/manifest.json and vault/public/ were written by the C# VaultBuilder on Windows from the ABSOLUTE path of input/; manifest.json source is only the directory name (manifestSource). manifestServices summarises manifest.json tokens by (type abbreviation, service). Relative paths inside manifest.json and vault-data.decrypted.json (files lists, fileHashes keys) use the OS separator, i.e. backslash here.
